name: The storm
story: The front forecast for three days. A blustery southeast morning, rain from late morning, the cold front through mid-afternoon with gale-force gusts and the cloud on the hills, then the wind veers west and the sky tears open behind it. By midnight it is clear, cold and very still - and the northern sky is green.
forecast: STORM WARNING, NO VFR 08:30-17:30. Southeast 14 kt gusting 20 by late morning, low cloud 250-300 m from 08:30, rain from 10:00. The cold front 13:30-15:00: wind veering southwest then west, gusts to 35 kt, cloud base 150 m, visibility 3 km in heavy rain. Clearing from 17:30, showers ending by dusk. Clear, cold night, aurora likely.
